product_metadata.title: ACME 0 Set of 2 Metro Bar Stool, Natural/White Finish, 29-Inch
features: Classic design and inviting bevel edged seats
Available in natural and white finish
description: This Metro collection bar stool features classic design and inviting bevel edged seats. This set of two barstools offers clean, casual style and ultimate versatility. Put them in bar, move them around a hobby table or tote them outside. Crafted of solid beech wood, the stools feature flared square legs for tip free steadiness, two sets of staggered rungs all the way around to park one's feet. Measures 29-inch seat height. Available in natural and white finish. It weighs 20-pound. Made in Malaysia.
